necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to these symptomatic episodes. This diagnostic monitoring is critical for managing the patient's complex cardiac history and addressing the unexplained dizziness.
